body_markdown:
Join us for an exclusive product tour of Freightos for Forwarders Ocean, a solution that brings the speed and efficiency of digital quoting to ocean freight.


It lets you compare routes by transit time and price, view all carrier surcharges upfront, and build accurate quotes in minutes—all within the same ecosystem you might already use for air freight.


**What We’ll Cover in 30 Minutes** :


- **Live Demo of Rate & Quote Ocean:** See how the platform lets you search contracts and dynamic spot rates in one click, view carrier surcharges upfront, and build accurate LCL/FCL quotes in seconds.


- **Q&A** : Get your operational and workflow questions answered directly by our product team in a live Q&A session
